2024 Q1.gq: For the forecast for fiscal year 2024, there is no change for what we have announced previously.

2025 Q1.gq: In preparations in the second half of the fiscal year, taking into account the additional improvement effects, we have maintained our forecast for the fiscal year.

2025 Q3.gq: Regarding the full-year outlook, services and platforms was revised downward due to revenue decline in the storage business, while front and IT services were revised upward.

2026 Q1.gq: For the full-year, we have raised our forecast by JPY 30 billion for revenue and by JPY 8 billion for adjusted EBITA.

2026 Q2.gq: For the full year, the revenue forecast is unchanged, but we revised adjusted EBITA upward by JPY 33 billion owing to productivity gains from process management, loss containment and other measures.
